meta.title: AI Generation Toolchain (2026)
meta.purpose: Current image/video models and when to route to each, so the system recommends the right tool per shot.
meta.note: Fast-moving space — treat versions as current-best snapshot; re-verify before relying.

video_models.route_for: photoreal cinematic shots, establishing, nature, hero beauty

strengths: multi-shot sequences (up to ~6 shots in one pass)

video_models.route_for: precise camera moves, controlled character shots, i2v with references
avoid for new pipelines; migrate off

image_models.route_for: storyboard frames, precise composition, automated batch (generate_frames.py)
consistent characters via training, controlled composition

routing_rules.when: precise camera move or character consistency

pipeline_pattern: t2i (still, chosen image model) -> i2v (motion, chosen video model) -> assemble/VO/music in editor. Keep character reference locked across shots for consistency.
